incidents.summary: Speedy Hire disclosed a £20.4m overstatement of non-itemised equipment assets caused by multi-year control and accounting problems, while its investigation ruled out underlying systemic fraud.

sources.title: Equipment write-down dents Speedy profit | Construction News
sources.quote: In February, Speedy revealed that the non-itemised assets it held (such as scaffolding tower, fencing and non-mechanical plant) were worth £20.4m less than it had previously stated.

sources.title: Equipment write-down dents Speedy profit | Construction News
sources.quote: Following an investigation, in May the company said the issue resulted from problems with controls and accounting procedures over a number of years.

sources.title: Equipment write-down dents Speedy profit | Construction News
sources.quote: But it concluded that it was “not the result of underlying systemic fraud perpetrated on the company by its staff or third parties”.
